story.originalTitle: "We're just a step behind" - what McLaren is trying to solve with its final 2026 upgrades
story.summaryEn: McLaren is still struggling with slow-corner performance after practice for the 2026 United States Grand Prix, with Lando Norris saying the team is "just a step behind." The team is working on revised suspension geometry and a different aerodynamic philosophy.
detailZh: “我们只是落后一步”——迈凯伦正试图通过2026赛季最后的升级解决什么问题
低速弯表现仍是“刀锋边缘”般MCL40的难题，因此迈凯伦一直在着手修改悬挂几何，并采用不同的空气动力学理念
“要让赛车变快，我们不得不拼命做到完美，而人不可能做到完美，”兰多·诺里斯在奥斯汀举行的F1美国大奖赛练习赛后说。
“我们只是落后一步。”
诺里斯本赛季中段的两场胜利现在看来更像是一段“高光期”，而非迈凯伦在2026赛季开局不顺之后竞争力复苏的预兆。在美国大奖赛上，车队引入了今年最终升级套件的第一批部件，该套件计划从本站到拉斯维加斯大奖赛之间分阶段推出。
尽管到赛季中段时，迈凯伦已将MCL40研发到在快速弯道中属于最快赛车之列的水平，但直线速度和慢弯表现仍然存在问题，赛车神经质的操控特性也同样如此。研发工作不得不在两方面之间取得平衡：不仅要创造理论上的性能，还要让赛车足够温顺，使车手能够挖掘出那份潜力。
“每个弯道都像在刀锋上行走，”这位卫冕世界冠军在新加坡说道。“你必须以精确到某个百分比的精度来驾驶它，而且你必须在各个方面强行操控赛车。你不能让赛车自己去做任何工作。你不能只让前部去做功，也不能只让后部去做功。你必须强行控制前部；你必须强行控制后部。
“你必须以需要极高专注力和极强能力的方式来驾驶它。这完全是全力以赴，而且精神上非常消耗，因为你在方向盘后面必须付出多么大的努力。”
“这实在太难了，这让在排位赛中做出完整圈速变得不可能，这恰恰说明了我们在匈牙利、荷兰和西班牙拿到杆位时做得有多出色，以及那种感觉有多值得。”
慢弯表现不仅仅是空气动力学的作用。尽管诺里斯的驾驶风格比许多其他车手更具适应性，但即便如此，这也要求赛车具备某些特定优点。他比其他车手更浅地切入弯心，油门和刹车的重叠程度更高。他的强项是对前轮在弯中何时获得侧向抓地力有着极强的感知，他利用这一点来帮助赛车旋转。
对他不利的是，悬挂系统趋向于采用高度抗后坐、抗俯冲的几何设定。尽管这稳定了赛车的空气动力学平台，但它抑制了关于每个车轴抓地力变化状态的‘感觉’传递。失去了这一点，诺里斯无法信任赛车的前端或后端——这就是为什么去年在迈凯伦为他开发了替代前悬挂几何设定后，他在缓慢开局后表现大幅提升。
在这种背景下，迈凯伦在奥斯汀的最新升级中率先采用修订后的前端几何设定，以及重新塑形的扩散器部件，这并不令人意外。据了解，下一阶段的升级将在巴西应用，更多升级将根据制造时间表在拉斯维加斯到来。
迈凯伦将在接下来几场比赛中为赛车带来的新部件，是在8月底的荷兰大奖赛和9月第一周的意大利大奖赛之间完成签批的，并且一直在推进生产流程。自那以后，迈凯伦的设计资源就完全集中在2027年的赛车上。
内部人士表示，车队在4月因巴林和沙特阿拉伯大奖赛取消而造成的空档期里，确定了一个新的空气动力学方向。他们相信，这最终会带来比车队赛季初所用概念更高的性能上限。
这在F1中相对常见，尤其是在新规则周期内。但人们很容易贸然下结论，认为如果升级套件没有立即带来显著的圈速提升，那就是以某种方式失败了。从工程角度看，这只是在建立新的基准。
迈凯伦在阿塞拜疆大奖赛周末推出了其新空气动力学概念的第一个版本，核心是截然不同的侧箱轮廓，以及扩散器内外导流件、地板前缘和后悬挂整流罩经过大幅修改的几何形状。车队谨慎地管理预期，强调并不指望圈速立刻大幅提升。
随后各种情况叠加在一起，使得新的配置表面上看起来效果不佳：诺里斯因燃油喷射问题受阻，而奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在比赛初期努力将马克斯·维斯塔潘和伊萨克·哈贾尔的赛车挡在身后，随后在第二次安全车重启时锁死轮胎，跌出了积分区。后来车队承认，至少部分直线速度的劣势是由于未能充分发挥其梅赛德斯动力单元的潜力。
“我们将在赛季最后阶段带来更多升级，这些升级是在巴库所交付升级奠定的基础上进行的，”车队领队安德烈亚·斯特拉在新加坡站后表示。
“巴库的升级原本预计幅度不大，但它为一些我们将在奥斯汀和接下来的比赛中开始带到赛道上的东西奠定了基础。所以对我来说最重要的是，我期待从下一场比赛开始看到我们的竞争力。希望我们能回到有能力登上领奖台的状态，并且希望一旦完整套件交付，能够为胜利而战。”
迈凯伦并不是唯一一支在试图提升赛车性能时发现自己要应对不稳定性问题的车队。梅赛德斯甚至在新加坡运行了两种不同的赛车规格，以试图理解其最新升级的行为——但值得注意的是，它在奥斯汀选择了最新规格。正如诺里斯在美国大奖赛周末前所解释的那样，升级F1赛车并不是一个可预测且线性的过程。
“升级并不总是装上就能见效，”他说，“它们并不总是那么容易发挥出全部潜力。我觉得我们这辆车一直都非常、非常难驾驶。是的，我们赢了两场比赛，我也拿到过几次领奖台，但优势都极其微弱。开着那样一辆车，你不可能稳定地做到这一点。”
“我们还需要在驾驶的轻松程度和更容易发挥性能方面改进这辆车。”
detailEn: "We're just a step behind" - what McLaren is trying to solve with its final 2026 upgrades
Slow-corner performance remains a problem for the "knife edge" MCL40, so McLaren has been working towards a revised suspension geometry as well as a different aerodynamic philosophy
"To get the car to be quick, we just have to try so hard to be perfect, and you cannot be perfect," said Lando Norris after practice for the Formula 1 United States Grand Prix in Austin.
"We're just a step behind."

Two mid-season wins for Norris now appear to be a 'purple patch' rather than harbingers of a competitive renaissance for McLaren after a troubled start to the 2026 season. At the US GP it introduced the first elements of what will be the final upgrade package of the year, due to be introduced in stages between this event and the Las Vegas GP.

Although by mid-season McLaren had developed the MCL40 to the point where it was among the fastest cars through quick corners, straightline speed and slow-corner performance have continued to be problematic, as has its nervous demeanour. Development has had to balance the process not just of creating theoretical performance, but also of making the car benign enough for the drivers to tap into that potential.

"It's just on a knife edge on every single corner," said the reigning world champion in Singapore. "You've just got to drive it within an exact percent, and you have to force the car in every single way. You can't let the car do any work. You can't just let the front do the work, or the rear do the work. You have to force the front; you've got to force the rear.
"You've got to drive it in a way that takes so much concentration and so much ability. It's just full-on and mentally draining because of how hard you have to work behind the wheels.

"It's just too difficult and it makes it impossible to put laps together in qualifying, which just shows how good of a job we were able to do when we were getting on pole [in Hungary, the Netherlands and Spain], and how rewarding that felt."

Slow-corner performance isn't just a function of aerodynamics. Although Norris has a more adaptable style than many other drivers, even this requires the car to have a certain set of virtues. He takes a shallower approach to the apex than others, overlapping throttle and brake to a higher degree. His strength is a tremendous feel for where the front tyres pick up lateral grip mid-corner, which he exploits to help rotate the car.

What operates against him is the trend towards running a high degree of anti-squat, anti-dive geometry in the suspension. Although this stabilises the car's aerodynamic platform, it smothers the transmission of 'feel' about the changing state of grip at each axle. Shorn of this, Norris can't trust either end of the car – which is why, last year, his performances picked up dramatically after a slow start when McLaren developed an alternate front suspension geometry suspension for him.

In that context it's no surprise that McLaren has led with a revised front-end geometry for this latest update in Austin, along with reprofiled diffuser furniture. It's understood that the next phase of the upgrade will be applied in Brazil, with more arriving for Las Vegas depending on manufacturing timescales.

The new components McLaren will bring to the car in the coming races were signed off between the Dutch GP in late August and the Italian GP in the first week of September, and have been making their way through the production process. McLaren's design resources have been fully focused on the 2027 car ever since.

Insiders say the team identified a new aerodynamic direction during the April interregnum caused by the cancellation of the Bahrain and Saudi Arabian grands prix. The belief was that it would ultimately lead to a higher performance ceiling than the concept with which the team started the season.

This is a relatively typical occurrence in F1, especially during a new rules cycle. But it is very easy to leap to the conclusion that an upgrade package has somehow been a failure if it doesn't deliver an immediate and significant lap time uplift. From an engineering point of view it is simply establishing a new baseline.

McLaren introduced the first iteration of its new aerodynamic concept in the Azerbaijan GP weekend, centring around a dramatically different sidepod profile, along with heavily revised geometries for the flow conditioners in and around the diffuser, the leading edge of the floor, and the rear suspension fairings. The team was careful to manage expectations, emphasising that it wasn't expecting a major improvement in lap time straight away.

Circumstances then combined to make the new configuration appear, superficially, to be ineffective: Norris was stymied by a fuel injection problem while Oscar Piastri laboured to keep the Red Bulls of Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar behind him in the early phase of the race, then dropped out of the points after locking up at the second safety car restart. Later the team admitted that at least some of the straightline speed deficit was a consequence of not getting the most out of its Mercedes power unit.

"We will be having some more upgrades coming for the final part of the season, which is the kind of upgrades that follow the foundation set with the upgrades we delivered in Baku," said team principal Andrea Stella after the Singapore round.

"The step in Baku wasn't expected to be big, but it was foundational for some stuff that we will start taking trackside as of Austin and for the coming races. So what's most important for me is that I look forward to seeing our competitiveness from the next race. And hopefully we will be back to being in condition to score podiums and hopefully, once the full package is delivered, to compete for the victory."

McLaren isn't the only team to find itself combatting instability as it tries to add performance to its car. Mercedes went to the extent of running two different car specs in Singapore to try to understand the behaviour of its latest upgrade – but, notably, it has opted for the latest spec in Austin. As Norris explained ahead of the US GP weekend, upgrading an F1 car isn't a predictable and linear process.

"Upgrades are not always just you put them on and things work," he said. "They're not always easy to get the full potential out of. I think we've had a car which has just been still so, so difficult to drive. Yes, we won two races and I had a couple of podium positions, but it was by tiny margins. With a car like that, you'll not be able to do that consistently.
"We need to also improve the car in terms of ease of driving and ease of extracting performance."

detailZh: F1美国大奖赛：汉密尔顿在FP3中险胜维斯塔潘
法拉利在COTA的每节练习中都排名第一，进入排位赛
汉密尔顿在F1美国大奖赛的最后一节练习中排名第一，领先维斯塔潘和勒克莱尔进入奥斯汀的排位赛
在第三节的最后20分钟里，汉密尔顿是唯一打破1分35秒大关的车手，频繁的越界行为使得法拉利队友勒克莱尔无法超越他登上排行榜。
本节练习的前三圈只能用平淡无奇来形容，但随着汉密尔顿在软胎上跑出1分36.716秒，超越了多个使用中等轮胎的圈速。
不久后，小红牛车队和迈凯轮的利亚姆·劳森打破了汉密尔顿的成绩，而几位重量级选手仍在使用中等轮胎进行圈速测试。
尽管范斯特appen对换挡时的不稳定状态有所抱怨，但他凭借黄色侧壁轮胎的1分35.702秒成绩名列前茅。
汉密尔顿迅速提升了成绩，使用软胎跑出了1分35.561秒。但勒克莱尔尽管使用的是较慢的中胎，却以1分35.127秒的成绩接管了领先位置，这表明还有更多的速度可以挖掘。
进入最后20分钟，安东内利在软胎上比勒克莱尔快了十分之一，但他在9号弯道超出了赛道限制，导致这一圈被取消。
维斯塔潘遵守了白线，以1分35.061秒的成绩排名第一，红牛车队在第一区段是最快的，但汉密尔顿的成绩低于1分35秒，达到了1分34.893秒。
在整个练习过程中一直出现的赛道限制问题，也阻止了勒克莱尔重新夺回第一的位置，因为他在10号弯道越过了白线。
这意味着摩纳哥车手只能满足于排在汉密尔顿和维斯塔潘之后，为周六下午的排位赛设置了一场紧张激烈的局面。
冠军车手安东内利排在第四位，领先于梅赛德斯车队的队友乔治·拉塞尔，银箭车队似乎在纯速度上落后半步，皮亚斯蒂在难以驾驭的MCL40中排在第六位。
在奥迪车队，尼科·胡肯伯格阻止了麦克拉伦车队的兰多·诺里斯获得第七名，世界冠军的1分35.2秒成绩也因为第十弯的赛道限制而被取消。
阿尔派车队的皮埃尔·加斯利排在第九位，落后汉密尔顿一秒，伊萨克·哈德贾在第二辆小红牛车队中排在第十位，这位法国车手因为他的赛车操控问题而感到沮丧。
detailEn: F1 United States GP: Lewis Hamilton pips Max Verstappen in FP3
Ferrari heads into qualifying having topped every practice session at COTA
Lewis Hamilton finished final practice on top at Formula 1's United States Grand Prix, leading Max Verstappen and Charles Leclerc into qualifying at Austin.

Hamilton was the only driver to break the 1m35s barrier in the final 20 minutes of third practice, as frequent track limits transgressions kept Ferrari team-mate Leclerc from leapfrogging him on the leaderboard.
Following an opening quarter of the session which can only be described as pedestrian, action picked up as Hamilton set a 1m36.716s on softs to get ahead of a number of medium-tyred install laps.
His time was soon beaten by Liam Lawson in the Racing Bulls and McLaren's Oscar Piastri, while several heavy hitters kept turning laps on medium tyres instead.
Verstappen even went top courtesy of a 1m35.702s on the yellow sidewall tyre, despite recurring complaints about his unsettling downshifts.

Hamilton swiftly improved upon the Dutchman's lap, using softs to set a 1m35.561s. But when Leclerc took over command with a 1m35.127s despite using the slower mediums, that underlined there was still a lot more pace to find.
Entering the final 20 minutes, Antonelli took a tenth out of Leclerc's time on softs, but his lap was scratched for breaking track limits at Turn 9.
Verstappen did adhere to the white lines to set a 1m35.061s and go top, with Red Bull the quickest car through sector one, only for Hamilton to dip below the 1m35s barrier with a 1m34.893s.
Track limits, which have been a recurring theme throughout practice, also kept Leclerc from reclaiming first as he dipped over the white line at Turn 10.
That meant the Monegasque had to settle for third behind Hamilton and Verstappen, setting up a finely poised qualifying session on Saturday afternoon.

Championship leader Antonelli was fourth ahead of Mercedes team-mate George Russell, as the Silver Arrows appears to be a half-step behind on pure pace, with Piastri sixth in the difficult to tame MCL40.
In the Audi, Nico Hulkenberg kept McLaren’s Lando Norris from seventh, with the world champion’s 1m35.2s also deleted for track limits at Turn 10.
Alpine driver Pierre Gasly was ninth, a full second behind Hamilton, with Isack Hadjar 10th in the second Red Bull as the Frenchman was left frustrated by his car's handling.

detailZh: 丹尼尔·里卡多在美国大奖赛前夕的现场表演令F1粉丝感到惊喜
前F1车手丹尼尔·里卡多与音乐家罗布·贝尔德一起吹奏口琴，令粉丝感到惊喜
丹尼尔·里卡多，Drive to Survive第七季
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
前一级方程式车手丹尼尔·里卡多在美国德克萨斯州奥斯汀的舞台上出现了一个惊喜。
这位澳大利亚人与歌手兼词曲作者罗布·贝尔德一起加入了福特赛车和Enchanté快闪活动，在周五晚上一起演奏他与美国大奖赛旅途中共创作的原创歌曲。
一位粉丝在Instagram上发布的表演视频，截至写作时已经获得了超过7000个赞。一位粉丝评论说：“这治愈了我心中的某一部分，”另一位粉丝补充说：“我敢打赌他上辈子要么是鲍勃·迪伦的兄弟，要么是个牛仔哈哈。我们爱你，丹尼尔。”
“在这个时候，没有人关心比赛。很高兴看到丹尼尔回来了，即使他不再赛车，”另一位粉丝写道，另一位粉丝写道：“作为一个音乐家和蜜獾粉丝，和丹尼·里卡多一起演奏是我的梦想。”
“我是说真的很长的一段路。沙漠、乡村小道、游泳洞，所有这些。说实话，我迫不及待了。”
这次长途旅行是推广新系列 Enchanté Collection 的活动之一，名为《长途》。这些新产品在奥斯汀的 Distribution Hall 的临时展位上出售，展位上还有食品、饮料、闪粉纹身和赛车模拟器。
里卡多也被看到在支持 小红牛 车队的车手利亚姆·劳森，作为新西兰人，他在 Esses Bazaar ATX 活动中担任主角，与利亚姆·劳森和朋友们一起在东第六街的 Inn Cahoots 举办车库音乐会，此次活动是为本周末的美国大奖赛做准备。
detailEn: Daniel Ricciardo surprises F1 fans with on-stage performance ahead of US GP
Former Formula 1 driver Daniel Ricciardo surprised fans with a harmonica performance alongside musician Rob Baird
Daniel Ricciardo , Drive to Survive Season 7
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
Former Formula 1 driver Daniel Ricciardo made a surprise appearance on stage in Austin, Texas, with American singer-songwriter Rob Baird.
The Australian joined Baird at the Ford Racing and Enchanté pop-up on Friday night to play harmonica on an original song he co-wrote with Baird during a road trip to the United States Grand Prix.

A fan video of the performance, posted on Instagram, had picked up more than 7000 likes by the time of writing. "This healed something in me," one fan commented, while another added: "I'm sure he was either Bob Dylan's brother or a cowboy in a previous life lol. We love you, Daniel."

"At this point, no one cares about the race. Glad to see Daniel back, even if he’s not racing," someone else posted, and another fan wrote: "As a musician and a honey badger fan, it would be a dream to play with Danny Ric."
"And I mean the lonnnng way. Desert, backroads, swimming holes, all of it. Not gonna lie, I can't wait."

The road trip was part of the promotion of the new Enchanté collection, The Long Road. The new products are being sold at a pop-up at Distribution Hall in Austin alongside food, drinks, flash tattoos and racing simulators.

Ricciardo was also spotted supporting Racing Bulls driver Liam Lawson as the New Zealander headlined Garage Sessions with Liam Lawson and Friends as part of Esses Bazaar ATX, held at Inn Cahoots on East Sixth Street ahead of this weekend's United States Grand Prix.

detailZh: 尼科·胡肯伯格在美国大奖赛上被加布里埃尔·博特洛托恶作剧后颜面扫地
加布里埃尔·博特洛托在美国大奖赛期间的一次粉丝见面会上玩了一个意外的恶作剧，让他的奥迪车队队友笑得前仰后合
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事
年轻的奥迪车手加布里埃尔·博特洛托在美洲赛道前与队友尼科·胡肯伯格走在一起时，对他进行了一次恶作剧。两位车手在奥斯汀观众的欢呼声中走出，巴西人拉下了队友的裤子。
这个时刻的视频已经迅速走红，展示了胡肯伯格在周五如何走上舞台，当时博尔特洛从后面抓住他的裤子并将其拉下，引发了观众的欢呼和笑声。这位德国人对此玩笑表示宽容，一边笑着一边整理好衣服。
这个恶作剧为博尔特洛艰难的周末带来了一些轻松。巴西人在周日美国大奖赛将从最后一排发车，因为奥迪为他提供的动力单元组件超出了分配额度。
博尔特洛和胡肯伯格自2025年以来一直是队友，当时车队还以萨博的身份参赛，尽管车队已被德国巨头奥迪接管，但他们成为了赛场上更为轻松的搭档之一。然而，车队在2026年很难获得积分。车队在车队积分榜上排名第八，积分为23分，胡肯伯格积13分，博尔特洛积10分。
博尔特洛在美国大奖赛周末赛前表示：“我在可靠性方面看到了很多改进。显然，我们在新加坡显然有一个问题，我们相信我们已经找到了原因。”
“这显然不是理想的情况，但与此同时，它发生的时候我并没有在前面真正地竞争，所以这让我对它稍微不那么沮丧。但我希望我们能够在接下来的赛季中没有任何重大问题，并且能够以最佳状态完成比赛和排位赛，驾驶我们能够驾驶的最好的汽车，从中提取一切。”
detailEn: Nico Hulkenberg left red-faced after Gabriel Bortoleto prank at United States GP
Gabriel Bortoleto left his Audi team-mate laughing after pulling an unexpected prank during a fan appearance at the United States Grand Prix
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

Young Audi driver Gabriel Bortoleto played a prank on his team-mate Nico Hulkenberg as the pair walked out in front of thousands of fans at the Circuit of the Americas. With both drivers walking out to cheers from the Austin crowds, the Brazilian pulled down his team-mate's trousers.

Videos of this moment have gone incredibly viral, showing Hulkenberg making his way onto the stage on Friday when Bortoleto grabbed his trousers from behind and pulled them down, to loud cheers and laughter from the crowd. The German took the joke in good humour, laughing as he pulled his clothes straight.

The prank offered some light relief on a tough weekend for Bortoleto. The Brazilian will start Sunday’s United States Grand Prix from the back of the grid, after Audi took him beyond his allocation of power unit components.

Bortoleto and Hulkenberg have been team-mates since 2025, when the team still raced as Sauber, and have formed one of the more light-hearted partnerships on the grid despite it being taken over by German giant Audi. The outfit has found points hard to come by in 2026, however. The team is eighth in the constructors’ championship on 23 points, with the experienced Hulkenberg on 13 and Bortoleto on 10.

"I have seen lots of improvement on reliability," Bortoleto said on Thursday ahead of the United States Grand Prix race weekend. "I think we had one [issue] in Singapore obviously, that we believe we found the reason of.

"It was obviously something not ideal to happen, but at the same time it happened when I was not really fighting at the front, so made me a little bit less upset about it. But I hope we are able to do the rest of the season without having any major issue and that we are able to just complete the races and qualifying in the best condition and the best car possible out there that we can drive and extract everything from it."
